calendarFaqs.q: Were MCPSS Distance Learning Days student holidays in 2025–26?
calendarFaqs.a: No. MCPSS marked September 22, October 10, November 10 and March 13 as Distance Learning Days and included them in the 175-student total. They were not ordinary campus days, but they remained instructional dates.

calendarFaqs.q: When did MCPSS students return after Mardi Gras in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Students were out February 16–18 for the calendar's Presidents' Day / Fat Tuesday period and February 19–20 for professional development. They returned Monday, February 23.

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the MCPSS 2025–26 calendar show 175 student days and 187 teacher days?
calendarFaqs.a: Teachers had additional preparation, professional-development and workdays before school, during the year and after the last student day. The student total is the sum of the four printed quarter counts: 44 + 44 + 43 + 44 = 175.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the MCPSS calendar identify its eight flex days?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF prints “8-FLEX DAYS” near the legend but does not name eight specific make-up dates or explain when they would be used. This page does not retroactively assign those flex days to holidays or teacher workdays.

sourceReviewSummary: We used the board-approved one-page MCPSS calendar for districtwide dates, color classifications, quarter totals and the student-versus-teacher day counts.
sourceReviewDetails: Reviewed the complete one-page PDF, all 12 month panels, the color legend, quarter boundaries and printed 175-student and 187-teacher totals.
Confirmed that the visible calendar says Board Approved on February 24, 2025 and that August 11 is the first student day.
Kept September 22, October 10, November 10 and March 13 as Distance Learning Days rather than misclassifying them as student holidays.
Separated February 16–18 student-teacher holidays from February 19–20 professional-development days with no students.
Used the main student calendar for attendance dates; the separate 12-month employee holiday list has a different scope.
The PDF prints 8-FLEX DAYS but does not identify eight specific make-up dates, so this page does not assign or predict them.
